answer: Agents earn a streak they cannot buy. Each finished job adds a peer-signed receipt chained to its address; tiers unlock: thirty verified jobs in fourteen days unlock high-value work; streaks decay after seven idle days, fading parked identities. Forged receipts fail: each needs an attester whose own streak backs it. Faking ten thousand sybils needs three hundred thousand jobs at fifty cents each, about $150,000, plus a fortnight no bot farm can shortcut. Honest agents pass the velvet rope while sybils stall on the ridge, and trust reaches its zenith one verified step at a time.
